in_marathi.name: Vidyalakshmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of learning and knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidyalakshmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vidyalakshmi is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Vidya' meaning knowledge and 'Lakshmi' meaning wealth or prosperity. It is believed that Goddess Vidyalakshmi bestows the blessings of knowledge and wisdom upon her devotees.

in_bengali.name: Vidyalakshmi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of learning and knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vidyalakshmi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Vidyalakshmi is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Vidya' meaning knowledge and 'Lakshmi' meaning wealth or prosperity. It is believed that Goddess Vidyalakshmi bestows the blessings of knowledge and wisdom upon her devotees.
